description.value: The CRDL Horsefly Branch is a community library in the remote Horsefly area, part of the 15-branch Cariboo Regional District Library network. It provides residents and visitors with access to physical collections, digital resources, and community programming. For touring cyclists in this sparsely serviced Interior BC region, it represents a rare public stop with connectivity and community information.

The fetched pages are system-wide and do not contain branch-specific amenity details for the Horsefly location, so required criteria and most optional amenities must remain null. blurb: Small community library in Horsefly in the eastern Cariboo.
